Hello Annabelle, 
Thank you for your feedback!! We truly appreciate your kind words and would be delighted to welcome you back again! 🐶🤎 …
Super friendly people, my dog was treated so well, especially by Irina

Best place for your dogs hair grooming and theeth cleaning. I always say my dog is blessed with the best with Anna. She knows exactly what I want and does an amazing job. I coulnt be more happier with her. Very talented and professional. The other best thing is that they can clean your dogs teeth without any anestishia, healthy mouth is a healthy dog. I would highly recommend Bloom per to every dog owner!!!

Great service
Loved how Marley looked after
We are very happy, and Luna is happy to thank u so so much.

Very gentle and empathic dog trimmer. 2 hr job, full monty, for my totally hairily outgrown Maltezer-Shitzu. Thorough treatment, well done, and for a fair price (I even got a deal for a lighter weight class).

Our 4 Maltesers visited Bloompet for the first time and they look beautiful!!

Sweet girls .. professional.. friendly, truly top-notch! Thank you and see you next time!

Pebbles bambam barney poppy

I went to this salon for a year with my little girl. Every appointment was like this. An hour before the appointment, they'd say, "Hello, could you come an hour later? We're having a tough time here." Of course, I'll come, but anything can happen. The last thing that really got me was waiting four hours for a 2.5 kg dog on the day of a strike. I had to come later, wait four hours, then write that my dog ​​was ready in 20 minutes. I showed up and they were still cutting her hair and told me to wait longer. They were good hairdressers, but I didn't have the time.

Anna is an amazing groomer! She is incredibly kind, patient, and gentle, and dogs absolutely love her. In just 2.5 hours, my dog was beautifully washed and groomed. She did an amazing job, and I’m very happy with the result. Highly recommended! ❤️

Very happy with the grooming of my Australian shepherd. He is 13 years old and now looks so fluffy and younger!

I also really like the communication and the team was very nice.

Thank you
We had a full groom for our Coco and was very  happy with the result ! Coco looked gorgeous and neat! I think we have found our place for him!

We’re so so happy with Bloom Pet! Our labradoodle Bobbie came out looking absolutely gorgeous, and she was completely relaxed and happy when I picked her up. You can tell they really take their time and genuinely care about the dogs. Highly recommend! 🫶 …

We are really happy with the results of the trim of our maltipoo. The trim was soooo good and it looks super cute. And it felt so okay to drop off our puppy, the ladies in de salon are so sweet. Thank you <3

I brought my puppy for her first groom. Everything was perfect!
I’ll continue to bring her to Bloom Pet
Munjie absolutely loved the experience and of course came out handsome after the cut. Thank you

Yesterday, we gave our poodle a haircut—it was absolutely amazing! ✨

Very neat and stylish work: her fur lays perfectly, her face is beautifully defined, and her ears look absolutely adorable.

Special thanks for the careful treatment—she came out calm and happy 🐩💖

Bloompet is the best dog grooming salon; both my Maltipoos go there and they both have different coats. They cut exactly as you wish, not a single hair sticks out, and everything blends beautifully—true craftsmanship!

Also not unimportant: they are very sweet to your dog 🐶
